name: orgcs-remote
author: Kevin Alexis Contreras
description: Keyboard shortcuts for the OrgCS console (Omni-Channel status, case list, case tabs), Omni-Channel statuses scheduled by time window, and status changes sent from your other devices through Bellwood's Satella relay, linked with a one-time code.

settings.title: Accept remote status changes
settings.description: Connects to Satella (wss://sa-695a7ab59cca49a99418ac589afaded0.ecs.us-east-1.on.aws) and changes your Omni-Channel status when one of your linked devices asks.

settings.title: Satella channel
settings.description: The relay channel commands arrive on. A private name is filled in the first time, and devices learn it when they link. Changing it means linking your devices again.

settings.title: Linked devices
settings.description: Devices allowed to change your status, by Satella key (64 hex characters). Extensions > Link a device adds them; delete an entry to unlink that device. Commands from other keys are ignored, and the key is written to the logs.
settings.placeholder: Filled in when you link a device
